Pattern: Worth naming: auto-generating a catalog from frontmatter via a quick regex script is fast but silently fails on multi-line YAML (folded '>' scalars, line-continued quoted strings) and on files missing frontmatter entirely -- it doesn't error, it just produces garbage ('>' as a literal description, an empty array). The fix wasn't a smarter regex; it was treating the generated output as a draft that gets read back and hand-checked against the real files, same as EC-VERIFY-FIRST-001 elsewhere. Also confirms two real, pre-existing catalog defects that predate this cycle and weren't introduced by it: desktop-commander/SKILL.md has no YAML frontmatter at all, and orchestrator-agent/SKILL.md's frontmatter name field ('orchestrator') doesn't match its folder name ('orchestrator-agent'). Neither was fixed here -- both are CTO-scope catalog hygiene, out of scope for a marketplace-setup cycle.
NextSeedIntent: Two real follow-ups for a future CTO-scoped cycle: (1) add YAML frontmatter to desktop-commander/SKILL.md so it's catalog-compliant like every other skill. (2) resolve the orchestrator vs orchestrator-agent name mismatch -- either rename the frontmatter field or the folder, pick one and make them match. Separately: only the ceo plugin has a commands/ entry so far (evolve-colony) -- the other 20 plugins have skills only, no slash commands, which is correct for now since no other command was requested, but worth knowing this marketplace is skills-first, commands are the exception.
